notes: Example only. The MHO98 clone states no numeric range for the timebase, CH1 vertical or cursor time settings, so the driver declares them operator_required and this overlay supplies narrow example bounds.

timebase_scale_s_div.reason: example: the bench uses 1 ns/div through 50 s/div

timebase_offset_s.reason: example: keep the horizontal window within five seconds of the trigger

ch1_scale_v_div.reason: example: 1X probe range of the MHO98 channel guide

ch1_offset_v.reason: example: keep the trace on screen for the bench signals

a_s.reason: example: keep cursor A within the displayed window

b_s.reason: example: keep cursor B within the displayed window
